newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat pre-opening calls mixed.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat pre-opening calls mixed.

text.p: There were mixed calls for the CBOT wheat futures open, traders said.
Calls for a one cent higher open were based on signals the market is oversold and on showers in the U.S. winter wheat region which could slow wheat harvesting.

But there were some ideas for a one cent lower open on persistent reports of excellent U.S. winter wheat yields and prospects USDA Friday will boost its estimate for 1997 U.S. winter wheat production.
Position squaring was expected before Thursday's USDA weekly export sales report and Friday's USDA crop reports.
CBOT's Project A overnight trend for wheat was one cent lower to 1-3/4 cents higher.
